summary: Auth knowledge is canonical: project.json architecture (identity zitadel, auth_profile b2b, organizations, rbac + optional cedar, postgres BFF sessions, separate system admin model) plus docs/authentication|authorization|multitenancy|admin with diagrams, verified against code; the 10 invariants are in CONSTRAINTS.md. Writing the docs surfaced and fixed two gaps (plaintext PKCE verifier at rest; no step-up re-auth for system-admin mutations). ./dev check runs config-check (identity configuration) and the auth/tenancy/admin/credential security suites.
